annotations.title: Discard or hold scheduled-post reviews in bulk

description:
[DESTRUCTIVE] Discard or hold 1–100 scheduled-post reviews in one call. Never approves or publishes. Use dryRun first to list would_discard/would_hold and skipped IDs without changing anything. Discard cancels permanently while keeping content, including already-rejected collabs; hold leaves posts in Held. Needs review or publish on the Agency plan, with the same brand restrictions as individual decisions. Results report partial failures per ID.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/reviews/bulk.)
